Collections pour tags :

Description :

1

A pair of Shoulder Pads I designed for Reptilian Overlords Spacenam Infantry models, but they can be used for any space army soldiers in need of some shoulder protection. I designed one blank and one with an embossed insignia. I included pre-supported files for both designs as well as the original unsupported STLs. I printed both designs supported files on an Anycubic Photon Mono SE, using Elegoo standard grey resin.

Description :

1

I was working on a paratroopers unit from Reptilian Overlords Spacenam Infantry and wanted to use the chest armor with no Tac Vest. I still wanted to add the chest mounted radio to the paratroopers units but the radio wasn't modelled seperately in the additional bits and accessories so, I made a replica and even added a bit more detail. I included the unsupported and supported versions.
